name: lang
title: Language switcher
description: A language switcher that is a row of links. Each link is a real page in its own language (decision 0025), named in its own script (English, कोंकणी, Konknni), with hreflang and lang on it and aria-current on the page you are on, so it works with no JavaScript, for search and for a screen reader. With JavaScript it fills in what the markup leaves out and can remember the last choice, never redirecting. The core also builds the hreflang links for a page's head and the address of a page in each language. Quiet is plain names with a hairline between; warm writes them in the hand with a pencil line under the current one; playful makes them stamped tabs. Devanagari and Romi are both finished: leading follows the script, tracking and capitals are switched off for Indic scripts.

budget.reason: A component: element 4 KB, pure core 6 KB (names, matching, hreflang, addresses, the pencil line and tilt), three small skins 2.4 KB. The strings mechanism is its own item (core-strings).

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
